verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies environment separation and never names a sandbox or staging environment. Windmill has workspaces with their own encryption keys, Git sync that can deploy commits into a workspace, and a Compare & Deploy review step that stages AI-made edits before they are deployed. A community user asks whether branch versions can be validated non-destructively, and the evidence leaves that unanswered. Missing for 10: an explicit dev/staging/sandbox workspace or environment feature, documented isolation of test runs from production data or resources, and hands-on corroboration of non-destructive testing.
